author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Nine people were displaced after an early-morning fire damaged a multifamily home on Steuben Street in Providence, according to the city fire department.

Firefighters were called to the property at about 2:23 a.m. Thursday. The department said crews located the fire in a bathroom on the third floor. Most of the damage was concentrated on that level, although the lower floors of the building also sustained damage.

The displaced residents include two children. One firefighter was taken to Roger Williams Medical Center with injuries the department described as minor. The report did not identify any injured residents.

Officials had not provided a cause for the fire in the source report. The extent of the lower-floor damage and the timetable for residents to return were also not specified. The incident adds a housing disruption for multiple families while investigators and building officials assess the property. The department’s account did not announce arrests or suggest that the blaze was intentionally set.
dek: A firefighter suffered minor injuries after crews found the blaze in a third-floor bathroom on Steuben Street early Thursday.
headline: Nine displaced in Providence multifamily house fire
